summary: Visual-only frontend verification for the OPC 3D residence (landing + /services). Captured screenshots at multiple scroll positions and inspected Envelope.jsx / Interior.jsx geometry. All items in /app/memory/visual_fix_checklist.md are satisfied on both the landing page and the /services GLB. No console/runtime errors on either page (only benign three.js deprecation warnings). Landing exposes window.__dbg (p, rotY, shellOp, addVis, addScale) for camera/scroll inspection.

issues: Console shows benign THREE deprecation warnings: 'PCFSoftShadowMap has been deprecated. Using PCFShadowMap instead.' and 'THREE.Clock has been deprecated. Please use THREE.Timer instead.' — not user-visible, but worth cleaning up on next pass.

verification_details.front_elevation: Two tall portrait first-floor windows (1.0 x 2.4) sit below the roof; two wider landscape (1.25 x 0.9) frosted+curtained upper windows are aligned above them — verified in Envelope.jsx L23-31 and in screenshots (services front, chapter-05 landing).
verification_details.entry_stack: Door 1.2 x 2.7 (tall pivot), canopy at y=2.88 attached without piercing wall, wood panel 1.2 x 2.66 centered at y=4.25 finishing just below Roof A at y=6.155. Screenshots show clean stack, no gap or z-fight.
verification_details.roof_wall: Roof A box at y=6.155 (h=0.14) overlaps the 5.6 wall top by ~15mm as intended; no flicker/bleaching visible in scroll sweeps (0->1 and reverse).
verification_details.cutaway_ch02: Chapter 02 (Kitchen + Bathroom Remodels) cutaway shows ground-floor living/kitchen (couch/TV/rug + island/stools), upstairs FRONT bathroom (vanity/toilet/framed glass shower), and larger REAR bedroom with bed pulled from exterior glass. Tile floor spans wall-to-wall in Interior.jsx L155.
verification_details.west_left_elevation: Two upper landscape windows at x=-1.55 and x=1.25 on the west wall (Envelope.jsx L86-93); front-adjacent one is frosted+curtain to match bathroom location.
verification_details.rear_elevation: Two centered upper landscape windows at x=-1.1 and x=1.1 on back facade of volume A (Envelope.jsx L64-70); confirmed in rear-sweep screenshots.
verification_details.services_parity: /services loads residence.glb (?v=14) and renders identical front elevation to the landing shared model (same window counts/proportions, wood panel, canopy, door). No runtime errors.
verification_details.scroll_transitions: Forward + reverse scroll sweeps (p 0->1->0) show no obvious roof/wall flashing; shell peels cleanly for the cutaway.

action_items: Optional: swap deprecated THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap / THREE.Clock usage to current API to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Envelope.jsx and Interior.jsx are single-file modules ~150-200 LOC — within limits, no split needed yet.
Roof A intentionally overlaps parapet by 15mm to avoid coplanar flicker — kept as documented; no change needed.
West facade has only one frosted upper window (front-side); intentional per checklist (bathroom is front).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page exposes window.__dbg = {p, rotY, shellOp, addVis, addScale}. Scroll positions: p~0 hero front, p~0.15-0.25 chapter 02 cutaway (kitchen + upstairs bath/bed), p~0.5-0.6 additions/rear rotation, p~0.85+ chapter 05 concrete+pavers front elevation.
